items.name: Toll-Chain Bracer
items.lore: A link of the chain the runaways put across the bridge, beaten into a bracer.

items.name: Fisher's Knot Ring
items.lore: Tadhg ties a fisher's knot in copper wire for anyone who helps him.

items.name: Runaway's Pledge Charm
items.lore: A lead token the runaways swear on. Breandan's sons all wear one.

items.name: Rowdy's Belt
items.lore: Studded, loud, and slightly too big. Like the rowdy who wore it.

items.name: Hazel-Sack Ring
items.lore: Woven from the drawstring of a smuggler's sack. It smells faintly of the well.

items.name: Sentinel's Courier Bracer
items.lore: Plain leather, Ceannai-stamped. Couriers on the south road wear them.

items.name: Breandan's Chain
items.lore: The toll-master's chain of office. He made it himself, from the toll chain.

items.name: Bridge-Warden's Ring
items.lore: Old Tadhg's father kept the bridge. This was his ring.

items.name: Turncoat's Sash
items.lore: Breandan's sash: Connla green on one side, eriu brown on the other.

items.name: Salt-Crust Charm
items.lore: River water, boiled down. What's left is sea salt.

items.name: Fili's Reed Bracer
items.lore: Marsh reed woven tight, the way the filid do it.

items.name: False-Light Lantern Charm
items.lore: A little glass ball with a sheerie's light trapped in it. It lies about where it is.

items.name: Morning Star Ring
items.lore: Carved from the figurehead of a wrecked ship.

items.name: Driftwood Bracer
items.lore: Silver-grey wood that once walked the shore at night.

items.name: Widow's Shawl
items.lore: Black wool. Maeve wore it for three years.

items.name: Drowned Sailor's Earring
items.lore: A gold earring, the kind sailors wear to pay for their own burial.

items.name: Night-Watch Bracer
items.lore: A watchman's bracer from Connla's docks, salt-stained.

items.name: Tide-Mark Ring
items.lore: A ring with a tide-line etched round it. The line is higher than it should be.

items.name: Morning Star Bell-Clapper
items.lore: The clapper of the Morning Star's bell, on a cord. It rang for the drowned.

items.name: Bell-Ringer's Cloak
items.lore: Grey and heavy, for standing on a cold quay all night.

items.name: Ebb-Tide Belt
items.lore: Sealskin, from the sailors' pier.

items.name: Ant-Chitin Bracer
items.lore: Shaped from a giant ant's foreleg. Harder than iron and much lighter.

items.name: Scout's Compass Charm
items.lore: A Sentinel scout's lodestone, in a twist of wire.

items.name: Mandible Ring
items.lore: An ant soldier's mandible tip, set in bronze. Still sharp.

items.name: Road-Keeper's Belt
items.lore: The belt of a Sentinel who keeps the south road clear.

items.name: Hill-Scout's Torc
items.lore: Bronze, light and plain. Scouts don't like anything that clinks.

items.name: Lost-Patrol Ring
items.lore: Found on the floor of the great hill. It belonged to a Sentinel.

items.name: Tunnel-Crawler's Bracer
items.lore: Scuffed to the bone from crawling.

items.name: Old Queen's Crown-Plate
items.lore: A plate of the Old Queen's head-carapace, hung on a chain.

items.name: Royal Jelly Charm
items.lore: Amber, with a drop of something golden inside.

items.name: Hive-Heart Cloak
items.lore: Spun from ant silk. It doesn't tear.

items.name: Moss-Light Charm
items.lore: A moss sheerie's light, given freely. It doesn't lie.

items.name: Dancer's Anklet Bracer
items.lore: Bells and moss. It jingles when you're about to be hit.

items.name: Ring-Dancer's Circlet
items.lore: Toadstool and silver wire. You feel like dancing. You don't.

items.name: Lullaby Ring
items.lore: It hums the sheeries' tune if you hold it to your ear.

items.name: Kirwyn's Trident Ring
items.lore: A merrow's ring, shaped like a trident. Kirwyn gave it freely, in the end.

items.name: Merrow-Scale Bracer
items.lore: Green scales that shine like wet stone.

items.name: Pier-Trader's Belt
items.lore: Sailors' leather, merrow-stitched. The old trade.

items.name: Hazel-Wood Torc
items.lore: Hazel wood, from the nine trees round the well. It's said to make you wiser. It doesn't, but it's very nice.

items.name: Seanchai's Story-Cloak
items.lore: Every patch on it is a story. Bebhinn knows them all.

items.name: Deep-Water Charm
items.lore: A pearl from the bottom of the well. It's very cold.

items.name: Treaty-Stick Charm
items.lore: An ogham treaty-stick, mended with silver wire.

items.name: Eriu Fishing-Torc
items.lore: Bronze, twisted like rope, the way the eriu make everything.

items.name: Brehon's Ring
items.lore: A judge's ring. Aodh gave you his spare.

items.name: Orla's Woven Belt
items.lore: Eriu weaving, taught to Orla in captivity. She's better at it than they are.

items.name: War-Arrow Charm
items.lore: The head of the eriu war-arrow, snapped off and kept.

items.name: Sentinel's Watch Bracer
items.lore: Ceannai-stamped. A Sentinel on watch wears one on each wrist.

items.name: Danderpaw's Claw Ring
items.lore: Danderpaw's claw, set in bronze.

items.name: Nasco's Net-Weight Charm
items.lore: A stone net-weight carved with Nasco's mark.

items.name: Solas's Watch-Cloak
items.lore: The cloak of the eriu who watched the south road. It's the colour of dusk.

items.name: Palisade-Scout's Ring
items.lore: A plain ring with a notch for every palisade post counted.

items.name: Totem-Splinter Torc
items.lore: A splinter of a clan totem, bound in bronze. It mutters.

items.name: Kedger's Fish-Scale Mantle
items.lore: Kaen Kedger's mantle of office: ten thousand fish scales, sewn one by one.

items.name: Chief-of-Chiefs Torc
items.lore: Gold and river-pearl. The eriu clans would follow whoever wore it. Nobody will.

items.name: Well-Caller's Staff Charm
items.lore: The head of a well-caller's staff. It drips, always.

items.name: Huscarl's Arm-Ring
items.lore: Bronze, heavy, and stamped with a leaping salmon.

items.name: Hazel-Gatherer's Ring
items.lore: A ring of plaited hazel twig. It never dries out.

items.name: Nine-Hazel Charm
items.lore: Nine hazelnuts on a cord. They rattle when the well stirs.

items.name: Stone-Singer's Torc
items.lore: Taken from a well-caller. The ogham on it is a lullaby turned backwards.

items.name: Standing-Stone Bracer
items.lore: Grey stone, cut thin as leather. It shouldn't bend. It does.

items.name: Ripple-Ring
items.lore: A ring that leaves ripples in the air when you move your hand.

items.name: Arracht's Fang
items.lore: A fang as long as your forearm. The great ollipheist won't miss it. It has hundreds.

items.name: Serpent-Skin Belt
items.lore: Ollipheist hide. It's never quite still.

items.name: Upriver Ring
items.lore: Found in Arracht's coils. Whoever wore it went upriver and didn't come back.

items.name: Orla's Song-Ring
items.lore: Orla's ring. She says it sings the low part.

items.name: Ceannai Lullaby Torc
items.lore: Silver from Ceannai, with a lullaby engraved round it in ogham.

items.name: Sinann's Tear
items.lore: A drop of the river that never dries. Sinann wept it when she understood.

items.name: Drowned-Hazel Cloak
items.lore: Leaves of the nine hazels, green again, woven into grey wool.

items.name: Well-Keeper's Torc
items.lore: The torc of the Lucht an Tobair, given to those who kept the well.

items.name: River-Mouth Ring
items.lore: Silver and green, the colours of the river where it meets the sea.
